title: Tavern 0.6.165 — restore Java shaker overlay position
native_evidence_scope: Restore maintained Forge/NeoForge ShakerOverlay centre-relative top-left coordinates for slots, bar and cursor; remove unsupported touch offset. Odd GUI dimensions may differ by up to half a logical pixel because Java uses integer division. No universal native touch-layout or rendered-client acceptance claimed.
public_notes_inline:
Restores shaker ingredients and progress graphics below the screen centre, matching the maintained Java overlay coordinates. Removes the unsupported top placement and extra touch-only shift introduced in 0.6.164. Gameplay, assets and other HUD controls are preserved.

Rendered device acceptance and complete Java parity remain pending.
